title.zh: Mistral Large 4 开放权重发布

excerpt.zh: Mistral Large 4 开放权重并强化编码与防御性网络安全能力，三档推理模式有望降低部署成本，但实际表现仍需独立验证。
excerpt.en: Mistral Large 4 now releases its weights with stronger coding and defensive cybersecurity performance, while three reasoning modes may reduce deployment costs. Independent testing remains important.

text.zh: Mistral Large 4 进入开放权重阶段
text.en: Mistral Large 4 Moves to Open Weights

text.zh: Mistral Large 4 是 Mistral 发布的一款约一万亿参数、原生多模态模型。公司表示，经过公开预览后的进一步强化学习，新版本在编码、防御性网络安全和推理效率方面都有明显提升，并将模型权重开放给开发者、企业和研究机构使用。
text.en: Mistral Large 4 is Mistral's roughly one-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model. The company says that additional reinforcement learning after its public preview improved coding, defensive cybersecurity, and reasoning efficiency, while the released weights give developers, enterprises, and researchers more control over deployment.

text.zh: 编码性能与成本控制成为重点
根据 Mistral 引述的评测结果，Large 4 在 FrontierCode 和 Terminal-Bench 等编码基准上领先开放权重模型；在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上，它据称以 48% 的得分接近领先模型，同时平均少使用 47% 的任务令牌。模型还提供低、中、高三档推理模式，让使用者在速度、成本和精度之间选择。
text.en: According to evaluations cited by Mistral, Large 4 leads open-weight models on coding benchmarks including FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench. On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, it reportedly scores 48%, close to the leading model, while using 47% fewer tokens per task on average. Three reasoning modes let users trade speed and cost against depth.

text.zh: 网络安全应用与主权部署
在网络安全方面，Mistral 表示该模型可用于漏洞发现、复现、验证和修补，并在 Cyber Index 上取得 51% 的成绩。公司同时称，模型对恶意网络安全请求的平均拒答率为 96.6%，意在区分防御性工作与攻击性用途。开放权重还支持自托管、定制和数据驻留控制，这对政府、受监管行业及安全团队具有吸引力。
text.en: For cybersecurity, Mistral says the model can help discover, reproduce, validate, and patch vulnerabilities, scoring 51% on the Cyber Index. The company also reports a 96.6% average refusal rate for malicious cyber requests, aiming to distinguish defensive work from offensive use. Open weights further support self-hosting, customization, and data-residency control, which may matter to governments, regulated industries, and security teams.

text.zh: 这次发布的意义不只在于单项分数，而在于把高端模型的运行控制权交给部署者。企业可以按自身硬件、数据和合规要求调整系统，也能审查模型行为。不过，基准成绩和供应商披露并不能替代独立复现；实际效果还会受到硬件成本、部署复杂度、数据质量、模型许可细节以及防护措施持续有效性的影响。
text.en: The significance is not only a set of benchmark scores, but also the transfer of operational control to the deployer. Organizations can adapt the system to their hardware, data, and compliance needs and inspect its behavior. Still, benchmark results and vendor disclosures do not replace independent replication. Real-world outcomes will depend on hardware costs, deployment complexity, data quality, licensing details, and whether safeguards remain effective over time.
